evidence.decision: Normalize the Stage-1 minting labels to durable historiographic base names. Keep the identity beginning at the 3 January 1868 Meiji Restoration, but do not back-project the later formal constitutional title as the base name. The exact formal 1889–1947 designation is modeled separately as a temporal polity designation.
evidence.temporal_designation: Empire of Japan / 대일본제국 / 大日本帝国 from the reviewed 11 February 1889 constitutional-evidence boundary through 2 May 1947.
